uint8_t * hwaMemOutRange
 HWA scratch memory for producing intermediate cfar detection list in Range domain, cannot be overlaid with other HWA scratch memory inputs for this DPU. Must be different memory bank than bank(s) of hwaMemInp. Must be aligned to DPU_RANGECFARPROCHWA_HWA_MEM_OUT_RANGE_BYTE_ALIGNMENT. Note this need not be the start of a HWA memory bank but typically it is, and is therefore naturally aligned to this alignment requirement.
